v: strI pragatA SAKAm atyA॰ sa॰ । agraSAKAyAm BA॰ karRa॰ 1068 Sloka॰ ।
m: प्र-शाखा f. a branch or twig, MBh.; R.
(prob.) extremity of the body, Suśr.
प्र-शाख mfn. having great branches (as a tree), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 177, Sch.
(also ˚शक) N. of the 5th stage in the formation of an embryo (in which the hands and feet are formed), Buddh.
a: प्रशाख — a. 1 Having many or spreading branches. --2 Being in the 5th stage of formation (said of the embryo, when the hands and feet are formed). --खा A small branch or twig.

m: प्र-शा˚ख-वत् mfn. (m.c. for ˚खा-व्˚) having numerous branches, R.
प्र-शा˚खिका f. a small branch, twig, MBh.
a: प्रशाखिका — A small branch.

प्रशांत — p. p. 1 Calmed, tranquillized, composed. --2 Calm, serene, quiet, sedate, still; अहो प्रशांतरमणीयतोद्यानस्य. --3 Tamed, subdued, quelled. --4 Ended, ceased, over; तत्सर्वमेकपद एव मम प्रशांतं Māl. 9. 36; प्रशांतमस्त्रं U. 6 ‘ceased to work or withdrawn.’ --5 Dead, deceased; (see शम् with प्र). --Comp. --आत्मन् a. composed in mind, peaceful, calm. --ऊर्ज a. weakened, enervated, prostrated. --काम a. content. --चेष्ट a. resting, ceased to work. --बाध a. having all obstacles or calamities removed; Ki. 1. 18.
प्रशांतिः — f. 1 Calmness, tranquillity, composure, quiet, repose. --2 Rest, cessation, abatement. --3 Allaying, quenching, extinction.

m: प्र-˚शाम् mfn. (nom. ˚शान्) painless, unhurt, ŚBr. (cf. ˚शान् above).
प्र-˚शाम tranquillity, pacification, suppression, W.
a: प्रशामः — 1 Tranquillity, calm, composure. --2 Quenching, extinction, allaying. --3 Cessation.

m: प्र-˚शामित mfn. (fr. Caus.) pacified i.e. subdued, conquered, Hariv.

s: [m] tri, prakarzeRa SAmyati yaH । (pra + Sam + kvip । “anunAsikasya kviJaloH kNiti .” 6 । 4 । 15 । iti dIrGaH .) SAntaH । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (sAmarTye nAnto'vyayo'yam ॥)
v: avya॰ pra + So bA॰ ani svarAdi॰ । sAmarTye
m: प्र-शान् ind. g. स्वर्-आदि (cf. ˚शाम्).
प्र-˚शान्˚ताराति mfn. one whose enemies have been pacified or destroyed, Prab.
प्र-˚शान्˚तात्मन् mfn. ‘tranquil-souled’, composed in mind, peaceful, calm, Bhag.; BhP.
प्र-˚शान्˚तौजस् mfn. = ˚तोर्ज, MW.

s: tri, (prakarzeRa SAntaH .) prakfzwaSamatAviSizwaH । yaTA, -- “praSAntaSvApadAkIrRaM muniSizyopaSoBitam ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe । 81 । 9 ।
m: प्र-˚शान्त mfn. tranquillized, calm, quiet, composed, indifferent, Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in augury) auspicious, boni ominis, Var.
extinguished, ceased, allayed, removed, destroyed, dead, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-शान्त &c. See under प्र-√ शम्.
प्र-˚शान्त—भूमिपाल mfn. ‘having the kings extinguished’, without a king (said of the earth), Rājat.
प्र-˚शान्त—धी mfn. = -चित्त, BhP.
प्र-˚शान्त—बाध mfn. one who has all calamities or hindrances quelled, MW.
प्र-˚शान्त—चारिन् m. pl. ‘walking tranquilly’, (prob.) N. of a class of deities, ib.
प्र-˚शान्त—चारित्र-मति m. N. of a Bodhisattva, Lalit.
प्र-˚शान्त—चेष्ट mfn. one whose efforts have ceased, resting, MW.
प्र-˚शान्त—चित्त mfn. ‘tranquil-minded’, calm, Vedāntas.
प्र-˚शान्त—काम mfn. one whose desires are calmed, content, BhP.
प्र-˚शान्तक mfn. tranquil, calm, Bhar.
प्र-˚शान्त—मूर्ति mfn. of tranquil appearance, Var.
प्र-˚शान्त—राग m. N. of a man, Cat.
प्र-˚शान्त—ता f. tranquillity of mind, MBh.
प्र-˚शान्त—विनीतेश्वर m. N. of a divine being, Lalit.
प्र-˚शान्त—विनिश्चय-प्रतिहार्य-निर्देश m. N. of a Buddh. Sūtra
प्र-शान्ति f. sinking to rest, rest, tranquillity (esp. of mind), calm, quiet, pacification, abatement, extinction, destruction, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-शान्ति—दूती f. ‘messenger of rest’, N. of old age, Kathās.
प्र-˚शान्˚तोल्मुक mfn. extinguished, W.
प्र-˚शान्˚तोर्ज mfn. one whose strength has ceased, weakened, prostrated, W.

प्र-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, (ep. also Ā.), to teach, instruct, direct, RV.; ŚBr.; R.; to give instructions to, order, command (acc.), MBh.; R.; MārkP.; to chastise, punish, MBh.; Kathās.; to govern, rule, reign (also with राज्यम्), be lord of (acc. with or without अधि), ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to decide upon (loc.), MBh.
a: प्रशास् — {c2c} P. 1 To teach, instruct, advise; Bk. 19. 19. --2 To order, command; प्रशाधि यन्मया कार्यं Mārk. P. --3 To rule, govern, be lord of; द्यां प्रशाधि गलितावधिकालं N. 5. 24; R. 6. 76; 9. 1. --4 To punish, chastise. --5 To pray or ask for, seek for (Atm.); इदं कविभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यो नमोवाकं प्रशास्महे U. 1. 1 (used in the sense of शास् with आ q. v.).

m: प्र-˚शासक m. = ˚शास्तृ, Pañcat. (B.)
a: प्रशासकः — 1 A director, ruler. --2 A spiritual preceptor.

v: na॰ pra + SAsa--BAve lyuw । SizyAdInAmizwAdiboDanAya kartavyatAvoDakavAkyoccAraRe “kzAtrasyEva praSAsanamaBUt” CA॰ u॰ ।
m: प्र-˚शासन n. guidance, government, rule, dominion, RV.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh.
enjoining, enacting, W.
a: प्रशासनं — 1 Governing, ruling. --2 Enjoining, exacting. --3 Government.

m: प्र-˚शासित mfn. governed, administered, R.
enjoined, enacted, W.
प्र-˚शासितृ m. a governor, ruler, master, dictator, Mn.; MBh.; Śaṃk.

s: [f] tri, (praSAstIti । pra + SAs + tfc । “grasitaskaBiteti .” 7 । 2 । 34 । iti nipAtanAdiqaBAvaH । yadvA, “tfntfcO SaMsikzadAdiByaH saMjYAyAYcAniwO .” uRA॰ 2 । 94 । iti tfR iw ca na .) ftvik । mitram । iti saMkziptasAroRAdivfttiH ॥ SAsanakarttA ॥ (yaTA, kAmandakIyanItisAre । 13 । 45 । “praSAstraDyakzasenAnAM mantryamAtyapuroDasAm । samyakpracAravijYAnaM duzwAnAYcAvaboDanam ॥”)

m: प्र-˚शास्त w.r. for ˚शस्त, ĀpŚr.

v: pu॰ pra + SAsa--uRA॰ sU॰ tfna saMjYAyAM aniwa ca । SastrarUpaSaMsanakarttari ftvigBede asajYAyAntu tfcuiw । praSAsitf । praSAsanakarttari rAjAdO ।
m: प्र-˚शास्तृ m. ‘director’, N. of a priest (commonly called Maitrāvaruṇa, the first assistant of the Hotṛ), RV. &c. &c.
a king, Uṇ. ii, 94, Sch.
a: प्रशास्तृ — m. 1 A king, ruler, governor. --2 A director, adviser; Pt. 5. 63.

v: tri॰ praSAstumidam aR saMjYApUrvaviDeranityatvAt na vfdDiH । SastrarUpaSaMsanakartfsambanDini ।
m: प्र-˚शास्त्र n. the office of the Praśāstṛ, RV. ii, 2, 1; ĀpŚr.
his Soma vessel, ib. ii, 36, 6.
1. प्र-˚शास्य ind. having ruled or commanded, MBh.
2. प्र-˚शास्य mfn. one who has to receive orders from (gen.), Bālar.
प्रशातिका See प्रसातिका.
प्र-√ शॄ P. -शृणाति, to break in pieces, break off, crush, RV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
प्र-√ शी Ā. -शेते, to lie down upon (acc.), RV.
प्र-शीर्ण See प्र-√ शॄ.
प्र-˚शीर्ण mfn. broken, smashed, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh.
प्र-शीत mfn. (√ श्यै) congealed, frozen, ŚBr.
प्र-शून mfn. (√ श्वि) swollen, Suśr.

प्र-√ शंस् P. Ā. -शंसति, ˚ते, (irreg. Pot. -शंसीयात्, Cāṇ.), to proclaim, declare, praise, laud, extol, RV. &c. &c.; to urge on, stimulate, RV. i, 84, 19; to approve, esteem, value (with न, to disapprove, blame), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to foretell, prophesy, Cāṇ.
a: प्रशंस् — {c1c} P. 1 To praise, extol, approve, speak approvingly of, commend; हरिणा युवतिः प्रशशंसे Gīt. 1; यच्च बाचा प्रशस्यते Ms. 5. 127; प्राशंसीत्तं निशाचरः Bk. 15. 65; R. 5. 25; 17. 36. --2 To esteem, value. --3 To declare.

s: strI, (pra + Sansa + BAve aH । striyAM wAp .) praSaMsanam । tatparyyAyaH । varRanA 2 IqA 3 stavaH 4 stotram 5 stutiH 6 nutiH 7 SlAGA 8 arTavAdaH 9 । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 184 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 10 । 127 । “Darmmepsavastu DarmmajYAH satAM vfttimanuzWitAH । mantravarjjaM na duzyanti praSaMsAM prApnuvanti ca ॥”) AtmapraSaMsAnizeDo yaTA, -- “na cAtmAnaM praSaMsedvA paranindAYca varjayet । vedanindAM devanindAM prayatnena vivarjjayet ॥” iti kOrmme upaviBAge 15 aDyAyaH ॥
v: strI pra + Sansa--BAve a । guRAvivkAreRa stutO hema॰
m: प्र-˚शंसा f. praise, commendation, fame, glory (with Buddhists one of the 8 worldly conditions, Dharmas. 61), ŚBr. &c. &c. (cf. अप्रस्तुत-प्˚, स्त्री-प्˚; w.r. ˚शंशा)
a: प्रशंसा — 1 Praise, eulogy, panegyric, applause; प्रशंसावचनं ‘a complimentary or laudatory remark.’ --2 Description, reference to; as in अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा q. v. --3 Glory, fame, reputation. --Comp. --उपमा one of the several kinds of उपमा mentioned by Daṇḍin; ब्रह्मणोऽप्युद्भवः पद्मश्चंद्रः शंभुशिरोधृतः . तौ तुल्यौ त्वन्मुखेनेति सा प्रशंसोपमोच्यते .. Kāv. 2. 31. --मुखर a. loudly praising.

m: प्र-˚शं˚सालाप m. applause, acclamation, Daś.
प्र-˚शंसा—मुखरानन mfn., ‘one whose mouth is l˚ w˚ pr˚’, speaking loudly in praise of anything
प्र-˚शंसा—मुखर mfn. loud with praise, praising loudly (˚रानन, mfn. ‘one whose mouth is l˚ w˚ pr˚’, speaking loudly in praise of anything), Rājat.
प्र-˚शंसा—नामन् n. an expression of praise, Nir.
प्र-˚शंसा—वचन n. pl. a laudatory speech, MBh.
प्र-˚शं˚सावलि f. a poem of praise, panegyric, Bālar.
प्र-˚शंसक mfn. (ifc.) praising, commending, MBh.; R.; HYog.
a: प्रशंसक, प्रशंसिन् — a. Praising, laudatory, eulogistic. --m. A panegyrist.

m: प्र-˚शंसनीय mfn. to be praised, laudable, Kād.

v: na॰ pra + Sansa--BAve lyuw । guRakIrtanena stutO । yuca । praSaMsanA'pyatra strI ।
m: प्र-˚शंसन n. praising, commending, Vedāntas.; Pāṇ., Sch. (w.r. ˚शंशन).
a: प्रशंसनं — Praising, extolling.

m: प्र-˚शंसिन् mfn. (ifc.) praising, commending, eulogizing, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚शंसित mfn. praised, commended, Pañcar.
a: {{प्रशसित->प्रशंसित||20170110||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्332,|}} — p. p. Praised, extolled, applauded.

m: प्र-˚शंसितव्य mfn. to be praised, praiseworthy, W.

v: strI kAvyAdarSokte arTAlaNkAraBede yaTA “brahmaRo'pyudBavaH padmaScandaH SamBuSiroDftaH । tO tulyO tvanmuKeneti sA praSaMsopamocyate” । tO padmacandrO tvanmuKena tulyO iti padmacandrayoH praSaMsitayorapi tvanmuKasASyena prarSasAtiSayAt muKasya ca saBaDikot karzavyaYjanAt praSaMsopamA ucyate ।
m: प्र-˚श˚ंसोपमा f. (in rhet.) laudatory comparison, comparing to anything superior, Kāvyād.
प्र-˚शंस्तव्य mfn. to be praised, praiseworthy, R. (cf. ˚शस्तव्य).
प्र-शं˚स्य mfn. to be pr˚, praisew˚, RV.; MBh.; R.; Uttarar. (v.l.)
preferable to, better than (abl.), Mn. ii, 95; Kull. (cf. 1. ˚शस्य.)
प्र-शंयुवाक w.r. for शंय्˚.
प्र-शठ mfn. very false or wicked (-ता f.), L.
प्र-शठ—ता f.
प्र-√ शद् only Caus. -शातयति, to cause to fall down, break off, pluck, Vcar.
प्र-√ शक् P. -शक्नोति, (fut. also, Ā. -शक्ष्ये, MBh.), to be able to (inf.), MBh.; Hariv.
प्र-˚शक mfn. w.r. for ˚सक्त, MBh.
प्रशक w.r. for प्र-शाख, col. 2.
प्र-˚शक्य mfn. one who does his utmost, Kauś., Sch.
प्रशल w.r. for प्रसल.

प्र-√ शम् P. -शाम्यति, to become calm or tranquil, be pacified or soothed, settle down (as dust), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to be allayed or extinguished, cease, disappear, fade away, ib. : Caus. -शमयति (rarely शाम्˚), to appease, calm, quench, allay, extinguish, terminate, ib.; to make subject, subdue, conquer, MBh.
a: प्रशम् — {c4c} P. 1 To become calm or tranquil. --2 To be soothed or appeased. --3 To stop, cease, terminate. --4 To be allayed, be quenched or extinguished; प्रशांतं पावकास्त्रं U. 6; Pt. 3. 56. --5 To decay, wither away. --Caus. 1 To soothe, appease, pacify; Ms. 8. 391. --2 To allay, extinguish, quench, put down; त्वामासारप्रशमितवनोपप्लवं Me. 17. --3 To remove, put an end to; तं ( अपचारं) अन्विष्य प्रशमयेः R. 15. 47. --4 To conquer, vanquish, subdue; Mk. 10. 60. --5 To settle, adjust, compose; प्रशमयसि विवादं कल्पसे रक्षणाय Ś. 5. 8. --6 To kill, destroy. --7 To cure, heal.

m: प्र-˚श˚मायन mfn. walking in tranquillity, BhP.
प्र-˚शमी f. N. of an Apsaras, MBh.

s: puM, (praSamanamiti । pra + Sam + BAve GaY .) SamatA । upaSamaH । yaTA, -- “etAni daSapApAni praSamaM yAntu jAhnavi ! ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ (yaTA ca harivaMSe । 98 । 81 । “sa tena vAriRA vahnistatkzaRAtpraSamaM yayO ॥”)
v: pu॰ pra + Sama--GaY na vfdDiH । 1 SAntO 2 nivfttO ca । praSAmyati pra + Sama--ac gOrA॰ NIz । 3 apsaroBede strI mA॰ anu॰ 19 a॰ । 4 rantidebasya putrepu॰ BAna॰ 9 । 24 । 25
m: प्र-˚शम m. calmness, tranquillity (esp. of mind), quiet, rest, cessation, extinction, abatement, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-˚शम m. N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-deva, BhP.
a: प्रशमः — 1 Calmness, tranquillity, composure; प्रशमस्थित पूर्वपार्थिवं R. 8. 15; Ki. 2. 32. --2 Peace, rest. --3 Extinction, abatement; Ku. 2. 20. --4 Cessation, end, destruction; Śi. 20. 73. --5 Pacification, appeasement; Śi. 16. 51.

m: प्र-˚शम—ं-कर mfn. causing the cessation of (gen.), disturbing, interrupting, R.
प्र-˚शमक mfn. one who brings to rest, quenching, allaying, Kāraṇḍ.

s: klI, (pra + Sam + Ric + lyuw .) mAraRam । vaDaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (pra + Sam + lyuw .) SamatA । praSAntiH । yaTA, -- “sarvvAvADApraSamanaM trElokyasyAKileSvari ! । evameva tvayA kAryyamasmadvErivinASanam ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARam । 91 । 35 ॥ (pratipAdanam । dAnam । iti kullUkaBawwaH ॥ yaTA, manuH । 7 । 56 । “tEH sArdDaM cintayennityaM sAmAnyaM sanDivigraham । sTAnaM samudayaM guptiM labDapraSamanAni ca ॥” sTirIkaraRam । praSamanena sTirIkaraRena । yaTA, raGuH । 4 । 14 । “labDapraSamanasvasTamaTEnaM samupasTitA । pArTivaSrIrdbitIyeva SaratpaNkajalakzaRA ॥”) iti mallinATaH ॥
v: na॰ pra + Sama--Ric--lyuw । 1 baDe 2 SAntatAkaraRe ca “labDapraSamanaKAsTyam” raGu “sarvAbADApraSamanam” caRqI Sama--BAve lyuw । 3 SAntO hemaca॰ ।
m: प्र-˚शमन mfn. tranquillizing, pacifying, curing, healing, MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.
प्र-˚शमन n. the act of tranquillizing &c., MBh.; Kām.; Daś.; Pur.; Suśr.
securing, keeping safe (of what has been acquired), Mn. vii, 56 (others, ‘bestowing aptly’; others, ‘sanctification’; cf. Ragh. iv, 14)
killing, slaughter, L.
(scil. अस्त्र) N. of a weapon, R.
a: प्रशमन — a. (नी f.) 1 Calming, tranquillizing, pacifying, removing &c. --2 Curing, healing. --नं 1 Calming, tranquillizing, pacifying. --2 Allaying, assuaging, soothing, mitigating; आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफलाः संपदो ह्युत्तमानां Me. 53. --3 Curing, healing; as in ष्याधिप्रशमनं. --4 Quenching, extinguishing, suppressing, quelling. --5 Cessation, abatement. --6 Bestowing fitly or on fit objects; Ms. 7. 56; (सत्पात्रे प्रतिपादनं Kull.; but others give it the next sense). --7 Securing, guarding, keeping safe; लब्धप्रशप्ननस्वस्थमथैनं समुपस्थिता R. 4. 14. --8 Killing, slaughter.

m: प्र-˚शम—रति-सूस्र n. N. of wk.
प्र-˚शम—स्थित mfn. being in a state of quiescence, Ragh.
प्र-˚शमि˚तारि mfn. id., Ragh.
प्र-˚शमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) tranquillized, relieved, quelled, quenched, allayed, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
atoned for, expiated, Uttarar.
a: प्रशमित — p. p. 1 Pacified, soothed, composed, appeased, allayed. --2 Extinguished, quenched. --3 Atoned for, expiated; U. 1. 40.

m: प्र-˚शमित—रिपु mfn. one who has all enemies pacified, Mṛcch.
प्र-˚शमि˚तोपद्रव mfn. one who has all calamities quelled, MW.
प्र-शर्ध mfn. (√ शृध्) bold, daring, RV.
प्र-शस् f. (√ 1. शस्) a hatchet, axe, knife, AitBr. (Nir., Sch.; others = प्र-शस्त, प्र-कृष्ट-च्छेदन &c.)
प्रशस्ता (आ), f. N. of a river, MBh.

v: pu॰ vf॰ saM॰ 14 a॰ ukte maDyadeSasTe giriBede ।
m: प्र˚शस्ताद्रि m. N. of a mountain to the west of Madhya-deśa, Var.

a: प्रश्नः — [प्रच्छ्-भावे नङ्] 1 A question, query; an inquiry, interrogation (अविज्ञातप्रवचनं प्रश्न इत्यभिधीयते); अनामयप्रश्नपूर्वकं Ś. 5 ‘with an inquiry about (your) well-being or health’. --2 A judicial inquiry or investigation. --3 A point at issue, a subject of controversy, controverted or disputed point; इति प्रश्न उपस्थितः. --4 A problem for solution or calculation; अहं ते प्रश्नं दास्यामि Mk. 5. --5 Inquiry into the future. --6 A short section of a work. --7 Basket-work. --Comp. --उपनिषद् n. m: प्र-श्रित mfn. bending forward deferentially, humble, modest, courteous, well-behaved (अम् ind. humbly, deferentially), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (often w.r. ˚सृत)
hidden, obscure (as a meaning), MBh.
प्र-श्रित m. N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-deva, BhP.

k.v: वश्यः प्रणेयो निभृतविनीतप्रश्रिताः समाः। धृष्टे धृष्णग्वियातश्च प्रगल्भः प्रतिभान्विते॥

m: प्र-श्रितम् ind., humbly, deferentially
प्र-√ श्रु Ā. 3. sg. -श्रिण्वे, to be heard, be audible, RV. v, 87, 3; to become known or celebrated, ib. iv, 41, 2 &c.
प्र-√ शुभ् (only Ā. 3. sg. pr. -शोभे = शोभते), to be bright, sparkle, RV. i, 120, 5.
प्रशुश्रुक m. N. of a prince (a son of Maru), R. (B. प्रशुश्रुव; cf. प्र-सुश्रुत).
प्र-√ शुच् Ā. -शोचते, to glow, beam, radiate, RV.
प्र-शुचि mfn. perfectly pure, R.
प्र-शुद्धि f. (√ शुध्) purity, clearness, MBh.
a: प्रशुद्धिः — f. Clearness, purity.

m: प्रशुक्रीय mfn. beginning with प्र शुक्रा (said of RV. vii, 34, 1), ŚāṅkhBr.
प्र-√ शुम्भ् (only 3. pl. -शम्भन्ते), to glide on wards, fly along, RV. i, 85, 1 (Sāy. ‘to adorn one's self highly’).
प्र-√ शुष् P. -शुष्यति, to dry up, become dry, Kām.

v: pu॰ pra + Svasa--BAve GaY । kozWyasya bAyorbahiniHsAraRe “SvAsapraSvAsayorgativicCedaH prARAyAmaH” pA॰ ta॰ sU॰ BAzyam । kumBakaSabde 2114 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: प्र-श्वास m. breathing in, inhaling, Suśr.
a: प्रश्वासः — Breath, respiration.

m: प्र-√ श्वस् P. -श्वसिति, to breathe in, inhale, MBh. : Caus. -श्वासयति, to cause to breathe, ŚBr.; to comfort, console, Hariv.
प्र-श्वसितव्य n. (impers.) recovery of breath i.e. recreation should be procured for (gen.) or by (instr.) or through or by means of (instr.), TUp.
